items.author: Novartis ACC
items.summary: Director, Intelligence Modernization & Productivity — Novartis ACC — United States (Remote, full-time) — posted Nov 25 (~45 min ago) — $185,500–$344,500 + bonus, possible equity. Seniority: Director. Industry: Pharmaceutical manufacturing. Experience: 8+ yrs. Key skills: business owner for analytics modernization and AI-enabled analytics workflows; governance standards; cross-functional transformation, change management and adoption; turning business goals into scalable analytics, workflow and technology capabilities; roadmaps, backlogs, prioritization, agile delivery, partnerships; Bachelor's required (advanced preferred); fluent English; pharma/biotech/life sciences preferred. No tools named; does not own AI platforms. Borderline: more operating-model transformation than BI.
